subject: general
question:
C is the third proportional of 57 and B. If B is the sum of the first three even natural numbers, then find the value of C.

(Rounded off to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**First three even natural numbers** (B) = 2 + 4 + 6 = 12.

Third proportional **C** = B² ÷ A = 12² ÷ 57.

C = 144 ÷ 57 ≈ 2.5263...

**∴ The correct answer is 2.53.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number (A) = 57

Second number (B) = Sum of first three **even natural numbers**

Third proportional = C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/680c924be402506210ce1747c665f5e88fa3a2ce382fa44653824d62be5d32e9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ B = 2 + 4 + 6 = 12

⇒ For third proportional: A/B = B/C

⇒ 57/12 = 12/C

⇒ C = (12 × 12) ÷ 57

⇒ C = 144 ÷ 57

⇒ C = 2.526315...

⇒ C ≈ 2.53 (Rounded off to two decimal places)

**∴ The correct answer is 2.53.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Third Proportional

If three quantities a, b, and c are in **continued proportion** (a:b = b:c), then c is called the third proportional, calculated as c = b²/a.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

Sum of First n Even Numbers

The sum of the first n **even natural numbers** is given by the formula n(n + 1).</p
